company_name: CÔNG TY TNHH CÔNG NGHỆ GIẢI PHÁP CITYNOW
benefits: Young, dynamic and friendly working environment.
Opportunity to become a full-time employee after completing the internship program.
Opportunity to work onsite in Japan.
Regularly organize seminars conducted by the company's own employees, facilitating research, exchange and development.
Being guided enthusiastically, creating many opportunities for development and promotion at work.
description:
1. Business Development & Market Research
* Research potential clients, partners, industries, and market opportunities in domestic and international markets.
* Identify and build databases of potential clients and strategic partners in the technology industry.
* Conduct research on industry trends, competitors, emerging technologies, and potential use cases.
* Support lead generation and outreach activities through email, LinkedIn, networking, and other channels.
* Support communication and follow-up with potential and existing clients/partners.
2. Content & Marketing Support
* Create and edit content for LinkedIn, website, email campaigns, and other communication channels.
* Support the preparation of content introducing Citynow, its products, technologies, use cases, and business solutions.
* Turn technical information into clear, engaging, and easy-to-understand business or marketing content.
* Support the creation and editing of posters, banners, event materials, brochures, and other marketing assets.
* Research and propose creative ideas for content, campaigns, and business communication.
3. Business Presentation, Proposal & Event Support
* Prepare and customize company/product presentations, proposals, quotations, and other business materials for clients and partners.
* Research clients and partners before meetings or events to tailor presentations and communication to their needs.
* Support Citynow's participation in technology exhibitions, conferences, job fairs, networking events, and other industry activities.
* Prepare booth materials, posters, handouts, and presentations for events.
* Communicate and network with visitors, potential clients, partners, and technology communities.
* Collect, organize, and follow up on leads after meetings and events.
4. Cross-functional Collaboration
* Work closely with Business Development, Product, Technical, and Marketing teams to prepare accurate and relevant business materials.
* Coordinate with internal teams to collect technical/product information and transform it into client-facing materials.
* Support contract-related processes by coordinating with relevant internal teams when required.
* Prepare reports on business activities, leads, opportunities, events, and market research.
requirements_text:
* Final-year students, or fresh graduates majoring in Business, Marketing, International Business, Economics, Information Technology, or related fields, currently seeking an internship.
* Available to participate in the internship at least 5 days per week.
* Cumulative GPA of 8.0 or higher.
* TOEIC ≥ 800 or IELTS ≥ 6.5.
